result.topic_en: Draft argument that if two pairs of functions satisfy Laplace's equation in a surface piece, then the boundary integral of u'∂u/∂p − u∂u'/∂p is unchanged when the region is altered within the domain of continuity, and is constant for any closed boundary lying in a region where the functions are continuous.

items.english: The value of the integral over the boundary of an arbitrary surface piece remains constant under any alteration and extension of it, as long as the discontinuity points persist (are still enclosed).
